_comment: Jobs-tab registry. Real file is config/jobs.json (gitignored, empty by default). Each job fires a script one-shot from the phone and/or on a Task Scheduler schedule (entries land under \AppLauncher\ in Task Scheduler). Kinds: python (default), powershell, batch, inline-shell, shell-wsl, http-check. See docs/jobs-tab.md for params, webhooks, secrets, and alerting.
